Qualified immunity is judicially created & refers to legal/court decisions that protect cops who violate someone’s constitutional rights. In the name of #AndrewJosephIII, we must #EndQualifiedImmunity. Follow @blmgrassroots and @GrassrootsBlack to learn more #BlackLivesMatter
